questions.question: At 8 o'clock last night, I _____ a book.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم الماضي المستمر لحدث كان جاريًا في وقت محدد في الماضي.

questions.question: The children _____ playing when it started to rain.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم were مع الجمع في تركيب الماضي المستمر: were + verb-ing.

questions.question: I was sleeping when the phone _____.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم الماضي المستمر للحدث الطويل، والماضي البسيط للحدث الذي قطعه.

questions.question: _____ I was walking home, I saw an old friend.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم While غالبًا قبل الحدث المستمر الذي كان يحدث أثناء وقوع حدث آخر.

questions.question: What _____ you doing at 6 p.m. yesterday?
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم were مع you في سؤال الماضي المستمر.

questions.question: English _____ in many countries.
questions.explanation_ar: المبني للمجهول في المضارع البسيط يتكون من am/is/are + التصريف الثالث.

questions.question: The classroom _____ cleaned every day.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم is لأن classroom مفرد، ويكون التركيب الكامل is cleaned.

questions.question: The old bridge _____ last year.
questions.explanation_ar: المبني للمجهول في الماضي البسيط يتكون من was أو were + التصريف الثالث.

questions.question: Correct the sentence: The letters is delivered every morning.
questions.correct_answer: The letters are delivered every morning.
questions.explanation_ar: Letters جمع، لذلك نستخدم are وليس is في المبني للمجهول.

questions.question: Put the words in the correct order: old / enough / is / to drive / he
questions.correct_answer: He is old enough to drive.
questions.explanation_ar: تأتي enough بعد الصفة، والترتيب الصحيح هو He is old enough to drive.

questions.question: There is _____ at the door. Can you open it?
questions.explanation_ar: Someone تعني شخصًا ما، وهي مناسبة عند الإشارة إلى شخص عند الباب.

questions.question: I looked everywhere, but I found _____.
questions.explanation_ar: Nothing تعني لا شيء، وهي مناسبة لمعنى أنني لم أجد أي شيء.

questions.question: This is the book _____ I borrowed from the library.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم which للإشارة إلى الأشياء، مثل book.

questions.question: This blue bag belongs to me. It is _____.
questions.explanation_ar: Mine ضمير ملكية يعني لي أو ملكي، ويأتي دون اسم بعده.

questions.question: She made this cake by _____.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم herself مع she عندما يقوم الشخص بالفعل بنفسه.

questions.question: Match each health word with its Arabic meaning.
questions.explanation_ar: تساعد هذه المفردات على الحديث عن الصحة والعادات اليومية المفيدة.

questions.question: What should you do when you feel very thirsty?
questions.explanation_ar: شرب الماء يساعد على ترطيب الجسم عند الشعور بالعطش.

questions.question: Match each job with its workplace.
questions.explanation_ar: اربط كل مهنة بالمكان الذي يعمل فيه الشخص عادةً.

questions.question: A very strong shaking of the ground is called an _____.
questions.explanation_ar: Earthquake تعني زلزالًا، وهو اهتزاز مفاجئ للأرض.

questions.question: A large area of land surrounded by water is an _____.
questions.explanation_ar: Island تعني جزيرة، وهي أرض تحيط بها المياه من جميع الجهات.

questions.passage: Last year, our school started a small garden. The students planted tomatoes, carrots, and flowers. Every class had a special day to water the plants. Some students made signs to explain how plants grow. After a few months, the vegetables were ready to collect. The school used some of them in a healthy lunch. Everyone was happy because they had worked together.
questions.question: What did the students plant?
questions.explanation_ar: يذكر النص أن الطلاب زرعوا الطماطم والجزر والزهور.

questions.passage: Last year, our school started a small garden. The students planted tomatoes, carrots, and flowers. Every class had a special day to water the plants. Some students made signs to explain how plants grow. After a few months, the vegetables were ready to collect. The school used some of them in a healthy lunch. Everyone was happy because they had worked together.
questions.question: Why did the students water the plants on different days?
options: Each class had a special day
The plants did not need water
Only the teachers could water them
questions.correct_answer: Each class had a special day
questions.explanation_ar: كان لكل صف يوم خاص لسقي النباتات، كما ورد في النص.

questions.passage: Last year, our school started a small garden. The students planted tomatoes, carrots, and flowers. Every class had a special day to water the plants. Some students made signs to explain how plants grow. After a few months, the vegetables were ready to collect. The school used some of them in a healthy lunch. Everyone was happy because they had worked together.
questions.question: What can we learn from the students' experience?
options: Teamwork can help people achieve a shared goal
questions.correct_answer: Teamwork can help people achieve a shared goal
questions.explanation_ar: الاستنتاج المناسب أن التعاون بين الطلاب ساعدهم على إنجاز الحديقة والاستفادة منها.

questions.question: _____ it was raining, the children continued playing.
questions.explanation_ar: Although تعني بالرغم من، وتستخدم لربط فكرتين بينهما تعارض.

questions.question: Write four sentences about how to stay healthy.

criteria: Use clear and correct English sentences.
rubric.sample_answer: We should eat healthy food. We should exercise every day. We should drink enough water. We should sleep well at night.

questions.explanation_ar: اكتب أربع جمل تتحدث فيها عن الغذاء الصحي والرياضة والماء والنوم.
